verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes a Raise Disputes API for cardholder-initiated disputes and a Dispute webhook type for status tracking, but evidence submission is described as a manual pilot feature (zip upload via Customer Area) rather than a full programmatic evidence-submission flow, and there is no mention of network reason codes or provisional credit handling. missing for 10: network reason code mapping/taxonomy, API-based evidence submission (beyond pilot zip upload), provisional credit issuance/reversal handling, end-to-end resolution status detail in webhooks.
